about: Measurement of 2026-10-11: the production update probe, particles.ingest.pipeline.read_update_slot with its reported-change rule and its second reading, over tests/fixtures/update_probe/stay_pairs.json, 3 samples per row, with llm.semantic_lint and llm.verification both pinned to the named model (anthropic provider), default probe budgets. 'verdict' is the deciding reading's (changes, different, fixed, or null for no usable verdict); 'reasons' are the REASON lines of each reading in order (a reply that revised itself carries two). Measured list-price spend US$0.50.
relabelled: 2026-10-12, after the review brief on PR #815: trip-for-good and visiting-mit were relabelled not_changes (class decided-not-ended) and trip-back-home made report-only. The 'expected' and 'matched' fields below are as measured under the 2026-10-11 labels; tests/fixtures/update_probe/stay_pairs.json carries the current labels and six rows added after this run. The owner confirmed the revised labels on 2026-10-12 and renamed the class temporary-elsewhere to lasting-then-temporary, moving resident-this-week into it; the class fields below keep the names of the run.
engine: main at 6725e815 plus PR #801 (1.183.0); the probe prompt is unchanged by PR #801
